description.narrative: (Albania): .With FY 2018 funds, the Justice For All project will improve the performance of, and citizen trust in, Albania's judicial system, contributing to ICS Sub-Objective 1.1.2. As part of this, funds will be used to continue support for independent media and journalists to act as watchdogs over the progress of justice reform. FY18 funds will support the joint USAID-OSCE in Europe Justice Without Delays activity which applies information technology to courtroom management. Through Justice Without Delays, digital audio recording will be made sustainable in all courtrooms throughout the nation, and data on courtroom usage and progress of cases will be used to identify bottlenecks, enabling Chief Judges and court administrators to improve courtroom management. Justice for All will work with EU counterparts to update the courtroom scheduling system, increasing the availability of courtrooms for hearings and reducing the overwhelming backlog of pending cases. FY18 funds will contribute to the organization and administration of the High Judicial Council.Justice for All will use FY18 funds to continue leadership training for Albanian judges, building their skills to provide strategic direction for their assigned courts and take the necessary actions to improve their operation and administration. FY18 funds will also be used to continue support for the School of Magistrates, focusing on leadership, advocacy, public relations, and gender sensitivity. The FY18 funds will also contribute to training opportunities as well as grants to independent media and journalists to identify, investigate, and publish instances of corruption in the justice system. These funds will contribute to more thorough investigative journalism, investigation of economic crimes, and fact-checking using professional journalistic standards. Although this program will continue into subsequent FYs, closeout costs are included within the budget and additional funding will not be required...

Objectives for Albania: The five year project designed to strengthen the effectiveness and transparency of the courts in Albania aims to improve Albanian courts’ performance, the project will provide assistance to increase court efficiency, transparency, and accountability. Ultimately, the project aims to increase citizens’ trust in the judiciary.
